title: Bank Deposit Late-Delivery Refund Amount
content:
The late-delivery refund on a Bank Deposit transfer is the transfer fee collected on the transfer multiplied by the late-delivery refund share and divided by one hundred, rounded half up to the cent once at the end.

## Terms of the amount

1. **Transfer fee collected.** The total of the transfer-fee charges on the transfer's ledger. Card funding fees, OUR surcharges, resend fees and recall fees are not transfer-fee charges and do not enter it.
2. **Late-delivery refund share.** The late-delivery refund share is 30 percent.
3. **Ceiling of the share.** The share applied to the transfer fee is never more than 100 percent, and it is applied once to the transfer fee collected.
4. **Rounding.** The product is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, and at no earlier point.
5. **Days late.** A transfer's days late are the calendar days from its date of availability as last disclosed to its deposit date.

## Worked figures (hypothetical transfers)

| Transfer fee collected | Share | Transfer fee multiplied by the share, divided by one hundred | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3.99 | 30 percent | 1.197 | 1.20 |
| 1.99 | 30 percent | 0.597 | 0.60 |
| 9.99 | 30 percent | 2.997 | 3.00 |
| 0.00 (fee waived at booking) | 30 percent | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Days late (hypothetical dates)

| Date of availability as last disclosed | Deposit date | Days late |
|---|---|---|
| 12 June | 15 June | 3 |
| 12 June | 13 June | 1 |
| 30 June | 2 July | 2 |

Where a date of availability was disclosed more than once for the transfer, the date counted from is the last one disclosed.
